groups.title: Residential Fences
groups.summary: Privacy fences, ornamental iron, Hardie plank and driveway gates for Houston homes and HOA neighborhoods.
groups.intro: Texas Fence is a residential fencing company in Houston, TX. Whether you want to replace privacy fencing in your backyard, or you are looking to secure your front yard with a driveway gate and operator, Texas Fence has the resources and expertise to provide you with service you can count on. Talk to a representative and we can help you weigh the various residential fencing options and determine the best fencing solution for your particular situation.
groups.imageAlt: A cedar privacy fence with brick columns running along a back yard

A 6 ft post is set 24 in deep in concrete, a 7 ft post 32 in and an 8 ft post 36 in
Cedar is untreated, so shades and grain vary from picket to picket

services.title: Iron & Aluminum Fences

Aluminum lasts in the weather but costs more and is not as durable

about.title: From humble beginnings to the top of the market.
text: Texas Fence began as a one-man fence-building operation based in a home office and rental storage unit, guided by the vision of growing into the best in its field. Since 2003, Texas Fence has achieved milestone after milestone, becoming an established leader in the highly competitive residential and commercial fencing industry.

The key advantage of choosing Texas Fence for your project is two-fold: we know fences, and we care about our customers. Our mission is complete satisfaction on all projects, and we have grown our team and improved our company over the last decade to achieve that ideal, going the extra length for customers on thousands of projects per year.

Our focus early on was on serving exclusively homeowners by building fences on residential properties. Today we serve commercial customers with the same care and quality, and our crews have constructed commercial chain link, iron and aluminum, brick and stone and other fence products for schools, parks, subdivisions and apartment complexes.

We offer fence installations and replacements starting as low as $2,500 for smaller projects. Larger projects that require extensive work, custom work or premium materials can range into the tens of thousands of dollars, so we work closely with our customers to find the best solution that fits both their needs and budget.

faqs.q: What kind of warranties do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer a One Year Workmanship Warranty.

faqs.q: How much does fence installation cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the fence type, length and terrain. Wood fences generally start around $25 per linear foot. We offer free estimates.

faqs.q: Do you handle permits and HOA paperwork?
faqs.a: Yes. We take care of city permits and provide HOA documents for approval.

faqs.q: What fence lasts the longest in Houston weather?
faqs.a: Vinyl and powder-coated iron offer the longest life with minimal maintenance. Cedar also performs well when properly sealed.

faqs.q: At what depth do you set fence posts?
faqs.a: Typically a 6 ft fence post is set at 24 in deep in concrete, a 7 ft fence at 32 in in concrete and an 8 ft at 36 in.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during the installation?
faqs.a: No, all we need is a contact phone number if we run into any unexpected issues.

faqs.q: What type of nails are used when installing the fence?
faqs.a: We use hot-dipped galvanized ring shank nails. Aluminum and stainless can be installed also.

faqs.q: Is it normal to have different shades of cedar in my pickets?
faqs.a: Yes, cedar is a natural product that is not treated in any way. Because of this, every tree is unique in color and grain.

faqs.q: Who collects from my neighbors when sharing costs?
faqs.a: We can collect. It requires separate contracts for neighbors fence splits.

faqs.q: Can you work alongside a general contractor on a new build?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly coordinate with GCs, subcontractors and jobsite supervisors. We can follow site plans or build to spec.

faqs.q: Can you install during business hours?
faqs.a: We can schedule work during or after hours depending on your operational needs and site accessibility.

faqs.q: What do I need to know before having the fence installed?
faqs.a: Assess the purpose of the fence (privacy, pet or pool enclosure, property line), where it will be located (an existing location or a new surveyed one), what type you want (materials, height, style, features and accessories) and when you plan to have the work completed.

faqs.q: Is an iron or an aluminum fence better?
faqs.a: They both have positive and negative attributes. Iron, if pre-galvanized and powder coated, can last a long time and is very durable. Aluminum will last in the weather but costs more and is not as durable.

faqs.q: Do you offer stain for my fence?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer stain for both new and older fences.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a pergola and an arbor?
faqs.a: An arbor is typically smaller and used as a decorative entryway or garden feature, while a pergola is a larger, structural build that provides shade and outdoor living space. We build both.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to build a pergola in Houston?
faqs.a: Most pergola projects do require permits. We handle all the paperwork, permits and code compliance for you.
